caption:
Toxic के झटके के बाद Rocking Star Yash ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर ऐसी धाकड़ वापसी की है कि इतिहास ही रच दिया! 💥

8-day extended opening week खत्म होने तक Ramayana ने पूरे भारत में 686.26 crore का ग्रॉस कलेक्शन कर लिया है। इसमें से अकेले कर्नाटक से 101.35 crore की कमाई हुई है, जिससे यह वहां 100 crore क्लब में शामिल होने वाली 9th फिल्म बन गई है। 🚀

इस धमाकेदार कमाई के साथ Yash कर्नाटक के इतिहास में तीन 100 crore grossers देने वाले पहले एक्टर बन गए हैं! इससे पहले उनकी KGF Chapter 1 ने 135.36 crore और KGF Chapter 2 ने 182.96 crore की ऐतिहासिक कमाई की थी। 👑

Ramayana से पहले Yash और Rishab Shetty के बीच 2-2 फिल्मों की बराबरी थी, जिनकी Kantara (183.6 crore) और Kantara Chapter 1 (247.48 crore) ने यह मुकाम हासिल किया था। अब Ramayana कर्नाटक में 200 crore mark की ओर बढ़ रही है, जो उनके होम स्टेट में उनकी पहली डबल सेंचुरी हो सकती है! 🔥

क्या आपको लगता है कि Yash की Ramayana कर्नाटक में 200 crore का आंकड़ा पार कर पाएगी? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर दें! 👇

ctx.title: Box Office: Yash Makes History As The First Actor To Deliver Three 100 Crore Grossers In Karnataka!
ctx.summary:
After the debacle of Toxic, Yash has bounced back strongly with Ramayana, which crossed the 100 crore mark in Karnataka on its 8th day. 
 The post  Box Office: Yash Makes History As The First Actor To Deliver Three 100 Crore Grossers In Karnataka!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Toxic broke Yash’s winning streak, giving him a major setback at the box office. But now, with Ramayana turning out to be a juggernaut, he has made a roaring comeback in the game. In fact, the 8-day extended opening week ended on a high note, helping him make history in his home state, Karnataka. The Rocking Star has put his star power on display, with the magnum opus entering the 100 crore club in gross collections.
The Rocking Star has established himself as a big star of Indian cinema with KGF Chapter 2. With the historic success of KGF Chapter 2 , the actor’s fan following has increased manifold, especially in Karnataka. He’s been trying his best to make the Kannada film industry global, which has helped him gain a loyal fan base. Now, with the right film coming his way, he has hit a home run!
By the end of the opening week, Ramayana has grossed a whopping 686.26 crore at the Indian box office. Out of this, Karnataka alone has contributed 101.35 crore so far. With this, it has become the ninth film ever to achieve the feat.
With Ramayana entering the 100 crore club in Karnataka, Yash has made history by becoming the first actor to deliver three 100 crore grossers in the state. His KGF Chapter 1 was the first film to score a century in the state, grossing a huge 135.36 crore . It was followed by KGF Chapter 2, which amassed a massive 182.96 crore . Now, the Bollywood magnum opus is his third film to achieve the milestone.
Before Ramayana, Yash was in a tie with Rishab Shetty, who has two 100-crore grossers in the state: Kantara ( 183.6 crore ) and Kantara Chapter 1 ( 247.48 crore ).
Ramayana is going strong in Karnataka and, given the momentum, the film is on track to cross the 200-crore mark in gross collections. If this happens, the Rocking Star will taste his first double century in the home state.
